items.html:
Prince Masvaure is a left-hand batsman and is captain of Zimbabwe's squad to the 2008 Under-19 World Cup in Malaysia. He made his first-class debut in the 2006-07 edition of the Logan Cup, where he remained unbeaten on 50 and scalped two wickets against Kenya Select XI for Northerns. He has also represented Zimbabwe A.
Cricinfo Staff February 2008
